Wait, the standard "no touching" rule usually implies the King's move constraint. Let's re-read carefully: "Queens may not touch, including diagonally. Thus queens in consecutive rows cannot occupy columns differing by 1." This is the standard "No Touching Queens" or "Anti-King" constraint applied to N-Queens.
